title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Street〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Akito and the others haven't been dropping by lately.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... And after practicing so much and learning to sing all those new songs too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's because they're busy.
With practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's right.
Not to mention that they're second-years now and have a lot of changes to adjust to...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bleh... But we're so bored.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you have time to sulk, maybe you have time to practice yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
We'll go do it once we finish our juice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO. Thanks for the cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh... Where are you going, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just out for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Lately, Miku's been just casually disappearing as if she's KAITO or Luka or someone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Hey, MEIKO. Do you know what Miku's up to?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Up to?
She's just going to practice.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You mean Miku's practicing singing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you think Miku's the sort to call people out for not practicing but then slack off herself?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If you knew that then you shoulda said something!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does this mean Miku's also gonna be all, “Hey, look how much I improved! Didn't I do a good job?” when Akito and the others come back?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If she does that, then our improvements won't be half as impressive!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Len, we gotta go practice now!
MEIKO, thanks for the juice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No problem, and good luck.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(KAITO did a good job.
He really put together some hard songs.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That last line needs to be bang on the rhythm. Otherwise, those sharp lyrics come off all limp.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I need to pay attention to where I put the accents too.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want to be a better singer...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Kohane and the others will come up against so many more obstacles in the future.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And that's why they need someone who's got their back.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I want to be that someone.
I want to be the wind in their sails.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (To do that, I need to be a better singer...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(The better a singer I become—
The more confident I become, the more persuasive I'll become.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And then, I'll say it to them with a smile.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'll say, “You'll be fine. You have what it takes.”)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want those words to boost their confidence simply because they came from me.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a basic grasp of it all now. All I need to do now is just keep singing it until it's second nature.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Everyone, over here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Miku! We came by to practice!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome back, everyone.
